behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: interpreting uncertainty as 'doomed to fail', feeling efforts are also Meaninglessness
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: first Empathizing with the helplessness and worry, gently pointing out the difference between 'feelings and facts', using concretizing and small-step Questioning, inviting description of verifiable evidence and minimal viable actions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing financial pressure and housing security, worst-case scenarios repeatedly surface (being evicted, ending up on the streets)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: replacing realistic evaluation with catastrophic imagery, believing negative outcomes unavoidable
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Receiving the fear in a steady, low-arousal tone, inviting them to distinguish 'imagined pictures' from 'currently observable facts', guiding them through situation grading and probability estimation.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: At the end of a session, invited to set actionable job-search micro-goals and a schedule
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: returning the sense of control to the presently controllable range, trying to prepare in advance for future discomfort
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Affirms their proactive planning and self-efficacy, helps set measurable small goals and feedback cycles to support realistic and flexible expectations.
